name: MSC
recent: MSC 子公司 Rahman Hydraulic Tin 在停产近一个月后于 9 月恢复采矿作业。公司董事及高层在 8 月至 9 月期间有多笔股份交易，并在 11 月披露闭市期交易意向。最新季度营收同比大增但净利环比下滑。
notable: 子公司 Rahman Hydraulic Tin 在停产近一个月后恢复采矿作业。
独立非执行董事 Datuk Lim Hong Tat 于 9 月 7 日以每股 RM1.681 增持 60,000 股。
联席集团首席执行官 Nicolas Chen Seong Lee 于 8 月 21 日以每股 RM1.770 增持 20,000 股。
risks: 联席集团首席执行官 Nicolas Chen Seong Lee 披露在闭市期有交易意向。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 637.27 million，同比增 68.2%，环比增 39.4%；净利为 MYR 34.02 million，同比增 143.9%，环比减 20.8%；净利率为 5.3%，低于上一季度的 9.4%。

recent_en: MSC's subsidiary Rahman Hydraulic Tin resumed mining operations in September after a near one-month shutdown. Directors and senior management had several share transactions between August and September, and disclosed an intention to deal during the closed period in November. Latest quarterly revenue rose sharply year-on-year but net profit declined quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: Subsidiary Rahman Hydraulic Tin resumed mining operations after a near one-month shutdown.
Independent Non-Executive Director Datuk Lim Hong Tat acquired 60,000 shares at RM1.681 per share on 7 September.
Co-Group Chief Executive Officer Nicolas Chen Seong Lee acquired 20,000 shares at RM1.770 per share on 21 August.
risks_en: Co-Group Chief Executive Officer Nicolas Chen Seong Lee disclosed an intention to deal during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 637.27 million, up 68.2% year-on-year and up 39.4% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 34.02 million, up 143.9% year-on-year but down 20.8% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 5.3%, lower than 9.4% in the previous quarter.
